_note: Character generation happens entirely at newRun/newGame with no further actions, so `actions` is empty (per action-script.schema.md, an empty actions array is valid). The `seeds` array is the covering set this chargen fixture iterates: across it every class (Fighter/Thief/Magic User), all six races (Human/Elven/Dwarven/Wilmsry/Fridgian/Troll), a Samurai (plate + magic weapon), and the special-grant grimoire branches (Wizard/Illusionist/Summoner/Sorcerer/Apprentice/Warlock/Cleric) are exercised at least once. `seed` is the schema-required scalar (a representative single seed); the parity and determinism tests iterate `seeds`. See `divergences` below: Phase 23 (IDENT-02/IDENT-03) originally declared seeds 15/24, both since UPDATED (after/rationale) by Phase 40's spell table reshape + day-one damage guarantee (SPELL-04/SPELL-05), which also adds seeds 7 and 29; Phase 38 (ABIL-02, the Special Skills table reshape) contributed seeds 1/2/3/4/6/13/32.

7.rationale: Phase 40 (SPELL-04): this Wizard's book (Sense Presence/Mirror Self/Stun/Heal) has no damage-dealing spell under the narrowed day-one guarantee (Stun no longer counts — control, not damage). content/spells.js's Lesser Summon (roll: "derived", lesser: true, so dealsDamage is true) is spliced into the day-one pool at a derived-random position for this seed and itself satisfies the guarantee, so it is appended — no Freeze needed. Zero new main-rng draws — test/unit/chargen-rng-pin.test.js is unedited.

15.rationale: Phase 40 (SPELL-04, DELIBERATE RULES CHANGE, 2026-09-18): the Phase 23 Summoner/Summon level-1 override is retired — Summon is spell level 2 again, no longer usable-now, so it no longer counts toward the two-usable-now top-up on its own. content/spells.js's Lesser Summon (roll: "derived") is spliced into this seed's shuffled low-level pool at a derived-random position, displacing Heal from the final book; the Summoner is also deterministically granted Lesser Summon (already present here from the splice, so no duplicate is pushed). Zero new main-rng draws — test/unit/chargen-rng-pin.test.js is unedited.

24.rationale: Phase 40: Detect Magic renamed Map the Floor (SPELL-05, same table position, cosmetic). The Apprentice's ready set (Heal/Strength/Stupidity) still has no damage-dealing spell under the narrowed SPELL-04 guarantee (Stupidity is control, not damage) — Freeze is still appended by the day-one top-up, now checking dealsDamage instead of the retired isAttackSpell top-up, same result for this seed. This seed's Lesser Summon derived-random splice landed outside the day-one/spare cutoff, so it does not appear here — expected variance (test/unit/day-one-damage.test.js proves it appears for other seeds). Zero new main-rng draws.

29.rationale: Phase 40 (SPELL-05): pure rename at the same table position — Detect Magic becomes Map the Floor. The Warlock cannot learn the special school (content/mu-chart.js: special: null), so Lesser Summon is never in its learnable pool and this is the ONLY change; Freeze already satisfied the day-one damage guarantee before and after this phase.

QUICK-260918-w4n (2026-09-18): the Cloak of Healing was removed from the game (user ruling), leaving CLOAKS at 7 rows; the Thief starting cloak roll now draws rng.d(CLOAKS.length) — the SAME single draw as before, but this seed's u now lands on a different row (Cloak of Armor instead of Cloak of Regeneration).
